CustomField.description: Active-run deduplication key. Held while the chain is running or stalled; cleared in the same update that writes any terminal status, so a finished chain frees its key for the next run. The unique index makes a second concurrent start with the same key land on the active run instead of creating a duplicate.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Identifies the active run of a deduplicated chain. While a value is present, starting another chain with the same key returns this run instead of creating a duplicate. Cleared automatically when the chain finishes. Managed by the framework; shown for diagnostics.
CustomField.label: Active Deduplication Key
